SMA-864. Done so far:

- Task 3: `ModelTurnAccumulator::finish_reason(&self) -> &FinishReason` and `tool_call_names(&self) -> Vec<String>`; the local driver (agent.rs, the `acc.finish()` Err arm ~line 1505) reads them before `finish()` consumes `acc`, and on Err with Length/ContentFilter sets the failure slot to `ToolCallsNotRun { finish_reason: Some(reason), tool_names }` and yields `RunFailed { error: err.to_string() }`; else keeps `AgentError::Other`.
- tests/tool_calls_not_run.rs exists; its tests collect with `RunResultStreaming::with_failure(stream, ctx.failure_handle())` — `RunResultStreaming::new` cannot read the failure slot. Use the same for your new test.
- Today the accumulator defaults `finish_reason` to `Stop` when no Finish arrives; keep that default for text-only turns.

- Read `finish_seen()` before `finish()` consumes `acc`, like the other two accessors. The no-Finish check comes first in the driver rule.
- Step 4: for a test mock that sends tool calls with no Finish, add the missing `Finish` (usually `FinishReason::ToolCalls`). 10:### Upgrade notes
11-
12-- This change is replay-breaking for a Temporal run that is in progress. It affects a run with a `Length` or `ContentFilter` model turn that holds tool calls. On replay, `transition` now fails the run at that turn, so Temporal reports a non-determinism error.
13-- Before the upgrade, drain the in-flight runs, or use a blue-green task queue. See "Upgrade Discipline and Determinism" in the `paigasus-helikon-runtime-temporal` crate docs.
14-- A `Length` or `ContentFilter` turn with tool calls now fails the run with `AgentError::ToolCallsNotRun`. Before, the loop ran the tool calls. On Temporal, the error arrives as `AgentError::Other` with the same text.
15-
16-## [0.8.3](https://github.com/SMK1085/paigasus-helikon/compare/paigasus-helikon-core-v0.8.2...paigasus-helikon-core-v0.8.3) - 2026-11-22
17-
18-### Fixed
19-
20-- *(providers)* SMA-854 send each anthropic text block at its own position ([#393](https://github.com/SMK1085/paigasus-helikon/pull/393))
21-
22-## [0.8.2](https://github.com/SMK1085/paigasus-helikon/compare/paigasus-helikon-core-v0.8.1...paigasus-helikon-core-v0.8.2) - 2026-11-22
--
44:### Upgrade notes
45-
46-- Build a `ToolDef` with `ToolDef::new` or `ToolDef::from_tool`. A struct literal and exhaustive destructuring no longer compile, because `ToolDef` is now `#[non_exhaustive]`.
47-- Upgrade `paigasus-helikon-core`, `paigasus-helikon` and the direct sibling dependencies together. Run `cargo tree -d` to check that the build has one copy of core.
48-- A tool wrapper must forward `Tool::provider_types`.
49-- The JSON of a `ToolDef` with no provider types does not change.
50-
51-## [0.7.0](https://github.com/SMK1085/paigasus-helikon/compare/paigasus-helikon-core-v0.6.0...paigasus-helikon-core-v0.7.0) - 2026-11-20
52-
53-### Fixed
54-
55-- *(core)* SMA-810 give each handoff transfer call a tool result ([#358](https://github.com/SMK1085/paigasus-helikon/pull/358))
56-
--
63:### Upgrade notes
64-
docs/book/src/concepts/agent-loop.md:51:A model turn can end with `FinishReason::Length` or `FinishReason::ContentFilter` and still hold tool calls. The provider cut that turn, so the tool call arguments can be incomplete. The loop fails the run with `AgentError::ToolCallsNotRun`. No tool call and no handoff from that turn runs.
